latestVersion.changelog:
Skill opend 1.0.1 – Adds OpenClaw secret-ref support and strengthens credential handling.

- Added support for OpenClaw-compatible secret-ref credential loading.
- Expanded documentation with clear instructions for secret management and source auditing.
- setup_config.py no longer prints reusable keys on creation, improving local secret safety.
- Introduced release checklist and registry metadata reference files.
- Improved warnings and guidance around credential methods for both hosted and local use.
- Other minor updates and clarifications in code and documentation.
